_about: Symposium talks whose slides were published as web pages with the talk-kit player
(a 16:9 #stage stepped by a DECK array), not as files in the Drive folder.
ingest/archive_symposium.py serves each built site locally, steps the player and prints
the stage once per slide, so the archive PDF is what was projected, with text kept.
root is the built site (asset paths are site-absolute), path the deck page under it,
live_url the published deck. Rebuild the talk site before re-exporting a revised deck.
The Drive folder holds one-slide placeholders for these; the deck sync skips them as stubs.
